name: Snuggle: MaxFi Robinhood vault

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The ProxyAdmin owner and the vault owner are the identical bare EOA (759 real transactions, a live key) - a 24h-delayed AdminSatellite exists, but it only covers two of the levers that actually matter, not the ones that do.
narrative.detail: addPool() (which can point the vault’s NFTs at an arbitrary position adapter) and updatePoolRewardAdapter() are instant; setAdminSatellite() is directly onlyOwner. The same EOA can also upgrade the implementation instantly through the ProxyAdmin - the 24h delay gates nothing that key cannot route around.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (1326 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x1195c074f898b7644ba732407619c9804dfe6dce","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","0x5416c47"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"0x5416c47"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x1195c074f898b7644ba732407619c9804dfe6dce","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (1326 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x5416c47"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 88173313 and 88173639 of the chain

reproduce.note: this RPC cannot replay the block of the build (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the call reproduces the current value, not the one of the build; compare the composite and lastUpdated with this page

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 1326 transactions sent; delay: none
